t7c2cb3b55: If a significant incident occurs, the controller must notify the ANPD (Brazil’s data protection authority) and the data subjects (art. 48) — and the ANPD’s regulation, Resolution CD/ANPD No. 15/2024, sets a deadline of three business days for that notice. That’s why the contract needs to state how and when the provider will alert you. Look for clauses on purpose and instructions, security, confidentiality, subcontractors, incident reporting and the return or deletion of data at the end of the contract.
t85bccd42e: DMARC is the doorman’s rulebook: it tells the receiver what to do when a message fails the checks — just monitor, send it to quarantine or reject it — and sends reports to the domain owner.

t926de6ad8: The safe path is to start DMARC in monitoring mode, read the reports and tighten the policy gradually. Since 2024, Google and Yahoo have required sender authentication, plus a published DMARC record from bulk senders. For an intranet, this makes a real day-to-day difference: a notice that lands in spam is a notice nobody read.
